sentences.text: first information statement of Smt. Vanishree.
The gist of the prosecution case is that Cw-1 got married to Accused No.1 on 15-01-1997 at Dharmasthala Kalyana mantapa, Bull temple Road asper Hindu customs.
At the time of marriage, the parents of CW-1 gave Rs.6,00,000/- worth gold ornaments to the accused.
After the marriage, CW-1 started residing with accused at No.55/1, 3rd main, Lakshmanappa garden, 3rd stage, Banshankari.

After the marriage, the accused used to pick up quarrel with CW-1 for silly matters, subjected her to cruelty and tortured her both physically and mentally in demand of additional dowry, forced her to give divorce.
When accused left to Bijapur, CW 1 to 3 and 5 met him, at that time, they requested accused take care of CW 1 and 5, he abused them in filthy words and gave life threat.
Based on the information of Smt. Vanishree, a case in Cr.No.89/2021 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
After completion of the investigation, the P.SI of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and was enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused caused physical and mental  cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry and  abused her and threatened and thereby accused has  committed the offences punishable U/s.498A, 504, 506  of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of D.P.Act..?
 2) what order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused , the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex . P1

is the first information Vanishree W/O Prakasha vs Prakash K on 8 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3528476/
3 statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1.

She in her examination-in- chief has deposed that her marriage with accused was performed on 15-01-1997 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked  5  C.C.No.30675/2022 after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused and threatened her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2

and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her. During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
 11.
On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.

As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was  6 Vanishree W/O Prakasha vs Prakash K on 8 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3528476/

sentences.text: In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.

Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
 12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., accused is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.498A, 504, 506 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.
The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
